Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism

Interface CubismPlugin

All Superinterfaces:
DeformerHooks, DrawableHooks, ModelHooks, ParameterHooks, PartHooks, TurboismPlugin
public interface CubismPlugin extends TurboismPlugin, ParameterHooks, PartHooks, DrawableHooks, DeformerHooks, ModelHooks
Convenience Preview entrypoint contract for Cubism integrations.

Plugins override only needed lifecycle methods. Runtime discovers inherited hook interfaces in deterministic plugin order; this contract deliberately exposes no callback-registration bus. Overrides are subject to lifecycle cleanup, callback isolation, and the host/provider admission rules described by the individual hook interfaces.
